subject: CS241
filterSummary: Filtered 264 out of 270 candidates due to: two topics (Karnaugh Map and Flip-Flop Conversions) had no matching videos, many were in wrong language (Hindi, English when Arabic needed or vice versa), too short (<60s), too long (>3600s), low relevance (e.g., general logic gates or unrelated), or duplicate channels. Only the best video per topic per language was selected based on highest relevance and quality scores.
